result:
The task is complete. Summary:

**Built and deployed** a real technical guard on VERIDIAN-DEV (`~/.bashrc` + `~/.profile`, sourcing `~/.claude-interactive-session-guard.bashrc-snippet`) that wraps `gh` and `git`: it blocks `gh pr merge` and `git push` to `master`/`main` unless the real systemd `INVOCATION_ID` env var is present, and passes everything else through unchanged.

**Caught a real gap during verification**: my first test of the exact `bash -lc` commands from the spec's SUCCESS_CRITERIA actually reached the real `gh`/`git` binaries (one attempted push to `claude-control:master`, rejected only by git's own non-fast-forward check, not by my guard) — because `.bashrc`'s own interactive-only check skips login-but-non-interactive shells. Fixed by also sourcing the guard unconditionally from `.profile`, then re-verified all three literal SUCCESS_CRITERIA commands plus the git-push cases.

**Shipped**: committed copy at `ai-os/OWNER_DIRECTIVES/interactive-session-guard.bashrc-snippet`, test suite at `tests/interactive_session_guard_test.sh` (18/18 passing), new protocol article `A15_interactive_session_write_gate` in `PROTOCOL_OWNER_AI.yaml` (single-protocol-file check still passes), and [PR #80](https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/80) — checkpointed to `pending_review` and left for the real supervisor pipeline to merge, deliberately not merged by hand.
